briefs.text: A cozy cafe. At least two tables (T) and a counter (C). A customer enters at S and should reach the counter nook G.
A small library. Bookshelves (B) along at least one wall, plus a reading table (T). A reader enters at S and reaches the reading nook G.
A dungeon entry hall. Stone pillars (P) and crates (X) for cover. The adventurer enters at S and reaches the treasure door G.
A flower shop. Flower buckets (F) and a counter (C). A customer enters at S and reaches the bouquet counter G.
A night market stall row. Food stalls (M) and crates (X). A visitor enters at S and reaches the food stall G.
A tiny hedge maze garden. The hedges must form at least two dead ends. A visitor enters at S and reaches the fountain G.
